summary.text: Dan Deasy is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 27 who has served since December 1, 2008 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as Daniel Deasy Jr.; he previously worked for the City of Pittsburgh and served on Pittsburgh City Council.

paragraphs.text: Dan Deasy, listed by Ballotpedia as Daniel Deasy Jr., attended the University of Pittsburgh.
His professional experience includes working as a supervisor for the City of Pittsburgh Public Works Department, and he served as councilman and finance chairman for Pittsburgh Council District 2.
Deasy assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2008.
He chaired the Liquor Control Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
